notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #10 – Sunbreak Digital Event Recap!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #10!

We’ve got an info packed post this week as we dive into the new monsters, hunting actions and more that have just been revealed during the Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak – May Digital Event!

We’d also like to extend a huge WELCOME to all the new Hunters that have joined us as part of the recent discount, welcome to Kamura!! If you’re looking for some pointers to help you settle in and thrive in Kamura, we’ve got some helpful posts you can check out below:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129434881277902033][b]Introducing Wirebugs & Mobility Usage[/b][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129435606049210916][b]Wirebug Usage – Aerial Usage[/b][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129437417942234611][b]Offensive Wirebug Usage – Silkbind Attacks[/b][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129438777523823846][b]Getting Started: Village Tips[/b][/url]

Make sure to pay Senri the Mailman a visit too, he’ll have some useful items, armour and weaponry to help you on your early hunts!

Now, we’ve got a Digital Event to recap…


[h1][b]May Digital Event – New Monsters, Hunting Actions and More![/b][/h1]

On May 10th we held our latest Digital Event for Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak, revealing even more fearsome threats that you’ll have to overcome in Elgado! But fear not, you won’t be facing them alone thanks to new hunting techniques and allies that will aid you in your journey…

[previewyoutube=kyFwal-l20A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Seregios[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/2428fc48d8e76ee3f04b6fc8710664530c67745e.jpg[/img]

Steel yourselves for a dance of a thousand blades with Seregios. This Flying Wyvern can detach and send razor-sharp scales flying in the direction of its prey... afflicting them with the Bleeding status ailment for a painful death of a thousand cuts. 

Those afflicted with the Bleeding status would be wise to watch their movement and seek a hasty recovery…


[b]Aurora Somnacanth[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/a54857ab7979ee732e22a2ed94b04c9411ae4b41.jpg[/img]

Bundle up and stay frosty when facing Aurora Somnacanth, a subspecies that has evolved to conjure up chilling breaths and bend ice to its will. 


[b]Magma Almudron[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/47719ee9c73e0007f0722daf91153a7c4ec39d48.jpg[/img]

Magma Almudron turns up the heat as it trades its signature mud manipulation tricks for searing hot molten lava. Keep your wits about you and watch your surroundings, what may seem safe footing at first can quickly change.


[b]Malzeno's Bloodblight[/b]

The Guild’s continued research on this mysterious Elder Dragon has gained new insight! It appears some of its power is derived from a malicious Bloodblight that it can inflict on its enemies. Hunters, we advise extreme caution when taking on Malzeno, lest it bleed you dry…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/3ae3c06d1c343755d9678b0fbd2fa3d9ababa740.jpg[/img]


[h1]More Hunting Actions[/h1]

With new monsters and subspecies looming on the horizon and reports showing that returning monsters are displaying new and varied sets of attacks and tricks, you’ll need to be ready for every possible situation to even the odds!

In Sunbreak you’ll be able to unlock new Switch Skills and Silkbind Attacks for all 14 weapons at your disposal. To make sure you’re ready for every possible situation a new technique has been honed, Switch Skill Swap!

[b]Switch Skill Swap[/b]

In Sunbreak, you’ll be able to assign individual Switch Skills to two groups: Red Swap Scroll and Blue Swap Scroll. This will allow you employ a wider variety of attacks and abilities during your hunts. This will be very handy when hunting multiple monsters in one quest, or if you want to try out a new Switch Skill without giving up an old favourite in the same slot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/e014f8e20378b674b85fe2d90a2de98e79a67200.jpg[/img]

For example, when playing Sword & Shield, you would normally have to choose between “Windmill” and “Metsu Shoryugeki”. Now you’ll able to assign “Windmill” to one of the Swap Scrolls and use for safely dispatching a pack of Boggi, then quickly swap to “Metsu Shoryugeki” to counter-attack one of Garangolm’s jump attacks.

Speaking of weapon combat, we’ll be showing off some examples and new tricks you can pull off with each of the 14 weapon types starting next week on May 16th. So make sure you’re following the [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]@MonsterHunter[/url] social channels and subscribed to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVS0xBpOtXBAl12rdG67-OQ]Monster Hunter YouTube channel[/url] to be among the first to see what’s coming up.


[h1]More Features – Follower Quests![/h1]

In your journey through Sunbreak, you’re not alone!

In addition to the standard selection of single and multiplayer quests you’re familiar with, we’re also introducing Follower Quests! This curated selection of special quests are single-player only and allow you to team up with some familiar faces from both Kamura and Elgado Outpost to take on fearsome monsters together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/229c133fa84211c5fe51616aa04c30b48a861a43.jpg[/img]

We’ve already had Hinoa and Minoto join us briefly during Rampage Quests, and we’ve been seeing Dame Fiorayne show off her Sword & Shield skills throughout various teasers... but with Follower Quests, you’ll be able to team-up with them throughout an entire hunt! Other characters will be able to join you as well, but we’re keeping the final list under wraps for now.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0N4lq9F1Dgrj30yMqn/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]Even More Content[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/18e8f89fcc2b6feaea33c624079ef89f53a5e693.jpg[/img]

[b]Navirou[/b]

Looks like we’re not done talking about guest characters, huh? Everyone’s favourite donut-loving Felyne and self-proclaimed hero, Navirou, is sneaking his way into Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak, in the form of a special layered armour costume decked out with fun custom animations and expressions! 

To unlock this, you’ll just need to own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1277400/Monster_Hunter_Stories_2_Wings_of_Ruin/]Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin[/url] on Steam!

[b]Title updates & More News[/b]

We’re also pleased to confirm that Sunbreak will receive several free title updates post-launch. We’ll have more news to share on the free updates, as well as even more exciting Sunbreak news around June – so watch this space!


[h1]The Hunt Continues June 30th![/h1]

Elgado Outpost awaits you when Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak launches on June 30th! 

Prepare to take on the Three Lords and everything this mysteriously land has to offer by pre-purchasing here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880360/Monster_Hunter_Rise_Sunbreak/

Hunters who pre-purchase will also receive:  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/249706b333b95f4b68005601d0da3c618d7d96e8.jpg[/img]

[b]Bonus Add-on Content[/b]
[list]
[*]"Loyal Dog Costume" Palamute layered armour set
[*]"Striped Cat Costume" Palico layered armour set
[/list]
Note: Layered armour is a "skin" which changes the appearance of the character without affecting their stats and abilities.


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks for taking the time to check it out.

We hope you enjoyed all the new details and reveals from the May Digital Event! What was your favourite reveal? Which new monster are you most excited to face? Let us know in the comments!! 

If you’d like to watch all 16 minutes of the May Digital Event you can do so [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0y-PV7puX-U]HERE[/url]. 

Also, one more thing - Starting the week of May 16th we’ll be sharing brand new Silkbind Weapon Skill videos on our Twitter account, so don’t miss out and drop us a follow on the official [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]Monster Hunter[/url] account.

We’ll see you in the hunt!

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #8 – Sunbreak Digital Event: New Content Recap!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #8!

In this week’s post we’re going to be diving into some of the reveals and juicy new info that was revealed during the Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak Digital Event on March 15th! 

To kick things off we revealed that Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak will be releasing on June 30th this year! You can pre-purchase it right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880360/Monster_Hunter_Rise_Sunbreak/

If you didn’t manage to watch the event live, fear not! At the end of this post, we’ll post a link to where you can watch it in full.

Until then though, let’s kick things off with our smashing new “The Three Lords” trailer…


[h1]The Three Lords[/h1]

[previewyoutube=oloUdNtE1HM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Introducing Garangolm![/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/okogzq9q0JyXewfXaW/giphy.gif[/img]

Garangolm is a hulking Fanged Beast that’s characterized by its massive, rigid body. Their sap-like fluids can promote plant growth, forging a symbiotic relationship with the flora that grows in their bodies.

Beware though, this sap is also used to harden plants and the surrounding soil, outfitting Garangolm’s body with dual fire and water elemental attacks!


[b]Lunagaron’s True Power![/b]

When Lunagaron was first revealed, little was known about the true nature of this fearsome Fanged Wyvern. The March Digital Event revealed that only when enraged do we see this monster’s true form…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jfTJz92tQHhwIMwjt0/giphy.gif[/img]

Upon entering an enraged state Lunagaron will make use of an organ that chills the air it inhales, rapidly creating ice armour to protect it from a Hunter’s blows. It’ll also change its fighting style, instead opting to rear-up on its hind legs and fight in a bipedal style, swinging its razor-sharp claws and blowing out ice cold breath.


[b]Mysterious Malzeno[/b]

There’s still much to learn of this mysterious flagship monster, but it does appear that this monster gains a sinister power by draining the life energy of other living creatures.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/M4pUAMrtKviM5wi0F2/giphy.gif[/img]

Once enough life energy has been harvested it’ll take on a more sinister appearance…


[h1]New Subspecies and a Returning Monster[/h1]

[b]Blood Orange Bishaten[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/CAUCtQU7p1zzMNN6JF/giphy.gif[/img]

Blood Orange Bishaten dances into Sunbreak, bringing with it a collection of explosive pinecones that turn up the heat on nearby Hunters. If you manage to avoid the blasting barrage, be ready to face an igniting breath attack!


[b]Astalos[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YwXNHEPti54bQxH9Ls/giphy.gif[/img]

Don’t be shocked by the electrifying return of this Flying Wyvern! Violent to a fault, Hunters beware – if Astalos has charged itself into a glowing frenzy, it’s ready to unleash mercilessly powerful attacks.


[h1]New Hunter and Buddy Actions[/h1]

[b]New Hunter Actions[/b]

We’ve loved the response from the community on Silkbind actions in Monster Hunter Rise, especially on hearing and seeing how you’re implementing them in the hunt. As such, we’re pleased to confirm that all 14 weapons are getting new Silkbind attacks in Sunbreak, among other things…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YzhwPoDjH7keRDpnrS/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Pierce the skies with your mighty Lance![/i]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jHOgFughLjHbHGIBOS/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]That’s a lot of hits, perfect for status and elemental weapons![/i]


[b]New Buddy Actions[/b]

Not to be outdone by their Hunters, Palicos and Palamutes are both receiving some powerful new tools in Sunbreak!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lAqjd3vlVck0nMBDhu/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/GhHAawO8KJLFMQeP89/giphy.gif[/img]

Not much has been revealed on their impact in hunts yet, what purpose do you think they’ll serve?


[h1]New Endemic Life[/h1]

[b]Marionette Spider[/b]

As you explore the lands surrounding Elgado, you’ll come across new endemic life including the Marionette Spider (Yes, it’s related to Kamura’s Puppet Spider!).

The Marionette Spider latches onto monsters, allowing the Hunters to pull it a specific direction. If there happens to be say, an obstacle or wall in the way well…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Hfk48hOyyyoHnIszxj/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]New Citadel Details[/h1]

We also detailed more about the new Citadel area that you’ll be exploring in Sunbreak. The Citadel is unlike anywhere you’ve hunted in so far in Monster Hunter Rise. Made up of multiple biomes, from woodland, to swamps, snow covered hills and even a ruined castle – there’s lots to discover as you find out what lurks in each area…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BJgV1ztO3rrzXVXnt8/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]Sunbreak Director Suzuki Update[/h1]

[i]The recently revealed Garangolm utilizes its sap-like fluids to outfit its body with hardened parts, allowing it to unleash elemental attacks. We can't wait for Hunters to go up against its powerful water and fire elemental attacks in-game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/4cf43f0bcd24613e7d0a0239162b33786ba91fd8.png[/img]

- Suzuki, Sunbreak Director[/i]


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks, as always, for taking the time to check it out.
We hope you enjoyed our look at some of the key features and content revealed during the March Digital Event!

If you’d like to watch it in full, just click [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1426343887]THIS LINK[/url] and enjoy the show.

We’ll be back soon with our next post. In the meantime, we’ll leave you with some news shared by Monster Hunter Series Producer, Ryozo Tsujimoto, from the end of the Digital Event:

[i]“There’s still plenty more to talk about, so we’ll have more information detailing new monsters and gameplay to share with you in the future, so stay tuned.”[/i]

P.S. You can keep up to speed with all things Monster Hunter by following us on our [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]official Twitter account[/url]!

We’ll see you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Monster Hunter Rise gets a free 13GB patch for Sunbreak
notes.content:
A number of additional free Monster Hunter Rise title updates are on the way, as Capcom prepares for the launch of the new expansion, Sunbreak, later this year. Both the Steam and Switch versions of Sunbreak will launch on June 30, 2022, as the devs have revealed in a new stream breaking down what players can expect from the expansion.

New event quests and "other content" will be added to base Monster Hunter Rise until March 25. A major free title update will launch alongside Sunbreak on June 30. This patch will require around 13GB of storage space, and will "adjust weapon balance, as well as add item packs and character edit vouchers, from the day Sunbreak is released".

If you haven't been keeping up with recent Rise updates, the devs also highlight title update 3.9.0.0, which launched in February and brought the PC and Switch versions of the game to parity with one another. This update introduced a host of additional armour and weapon sets designed to make progressing through the game easier, so you can quickly catch up with the content in Sunbreak.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.content:

This week we’re going to be taking an early look at a small selection of some of the new Event Quest content that’ll be arriving next week in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/6135594717209367552]version 3.9[/url]!

From the eagerly anticipated Universal Studios Japan (USJ) collab, to new layered armour, stickers, pose sets and fresh challenges to test your skills as a Hunter, there’s something for everyone!

Are your weapons sharpened and ammo loaded? Good! Let’s jump in…


[h1]New Event Quests Spotlight[/h1]

[b]USJ Collab – Two New Quests[/b]

Complete these quests to earn materials that will allow you to forge special armor and weapons for your Hunter, Palicoes and Palamutes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/1ca537f0607ced9effdb3e3f2c74264c20d08aec.jpg[/img]

Yes, that includes layered versions of the armour!


[i]USJ – Shrine Showdown![/i]

Take on a triple threat of monsters in this High Rank quest to craft the Azure Star Blade I (Longsword), Azure Era Wyrmbow (Bow) and Azure Age armour (and layered armour) set for your Hunter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/f8dd752defef65e7afc740ab9f89a30c7bb6000e.jpg[/img]

Rise above the combined might of these monsters and claim your prize!


[i]USJ – Arzuros Onslaught![/i]

Protect Kamura Village from an onslaught of Arzuros in this High Rank Rampage quest to kit out your Palico and Palamute with some special weapons and armour (including layered).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d9e155b9ca2034d787ba068ffd7f21190c973300.jpg[/img]

Equally fashionable and fierce hunting buddies!

As highlighted above, both of the above quests fall into the High Rank Event Quests category, giving you fun and skilful confrontations that are full of useful items and monster parts.


[b]Layered Armour[/b]

For some Hunters, fashion game is the endgame! If this sounds like you, then you’ll want to look out for these striking Event Quests!

[i]A Good Old-Fashioned Rampage[/i]

As the name suggests, this quest is a Rampage! If you can successfully hold the line and defend the final gate you’ll be awarded with the materials required to forge a rather special layered armour, the “Origin” set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/246ea0d22f49927a0fcfc05618661cc13e1c9fdd.jpg[/img]

This look is directly inspired by a set from the original Monster Hunter, a true classic!


[i]Frost Bites[/i]

Complete this quest to give yourself a cool new Winter look with the “Orion” layered armour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/6a68048178cd56ba66aeb61d8643f8e51cb3344f.jpg[/img]

What stands between you and this set? Well, you’ll have to best the ice-cold combo of Barioth, Goss Harag and Lagombi – watch out for that Iceblight!


[b]Pose & Stickers[/b]

[i]Wrestling with Pain[/i]

Take a seat, master Hunter, with the “Sitting Pose Set” that you’ll earn after taking down an Arzuros and a Tetranadon in this hunt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/afdd55f6c0f28ffe8c683d8b470c0b79d49ce1b3.jpg[/img]

This pose set contains a number of different ways to sit, letting you pose comfortably with your favourite villagers in Kamura, or even get comfy when you’re out on the hunt – a great set to unlock for Hunters who enjoy a bit of Cohoot photography!


[i]Princesses’ Banquet[/i]

You’ve been cordially invited to the Princesses’ Banquet! Survive the main course and you’ll unlock the sweet “Chocolate Set” of stickers to use in multiplayer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/58cce59d8c92e515a695677f1640b5037621647e.jpg[/img]

What stands between you and this tasty treat? A truly fearsome trio consisting of Rathian, Rakna-Kadaki and Somnacanth! Fear not though, you’ve got this covered!  


[b]Advanced Quest & Apex Emergency[/b]

Those of you that have already tried the existing Apex Emergency and Advanced quests will know that these are not for the faint of heart. They’ll push your hunting skills to new limits as everything you’ve learned so far is put to the test. Monsters in these quests hit much harder, have more health, increased resistances and are unrelenting in their aggression. 

We’ve picked two particularly fearsome hunts from the batch that will drop as part of version 3.9 to help prepare you for the battles ahead! 

[i]Advanced: Crimson Calamity[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/187da0c27ac1a47ed87671de2f8c08c5a1939ffd.jpg[/img]

Take on a powered-up Crimson Glow Valstrax in the Infernal Springs! How will you handle this monster’s signature “Ambush” attack in a limited space? There’s only one way to find out…


[i]Apex Diablos Emergency[/i]

Be on your guard with this quest, or it’ll end in a bloodbath! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/3312bb7fb564b09f82d0f34ad4658c30bc67bbeb.jpg[/img]

The Apex Emergency Diablos is far stronger and larger than its other kin you’ve encountered so far in [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i]. Be ready for a dance with destruction if you step into this quest. You’ll need to be on your toes throughout! It’ll probably be a good idea to bring strong ice weapons too...

Besting these quests will provide you with monster parts, armour spheres, Silver / Golden eggs and even generous amounts of Defender Ticket 9! Oh and an immense feeling of satisfaction having successfully demonstrated the depth of your hunting prowess!

These quests are hard though, so don’t feel bad if you faint! Every cart is a lesson learned!


[h1]Sunbreak Director Suzuki Update[/h1]

[i]Happy Valentine's Day from the #Sunbreak dev team! 💝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/a01b2074bf0f78744cd90173fdc536c3065429e1.png[/img]

- Suzuki, Sunbreak Director[/i]


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks for taking the time to check it out.
We hope you enjoyed this little preview of just some of the new Event Quests you’ll be able to jump into in the near future.

What quests will you be taking on first? Will you be chasing the USJ collab and new cosmetics, or are you going headfirst into some really challenging hunts? Let us know in the comments!

As always, we’ll be back again soon with our next post, and in the meantime, we’ll be reading through your comments here on the Steam forums. You can also keep up to speed with all things Monster Hunter by following us on our [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]official Twitter account[/url].

Have a great weekend everyone, we’ll see you in the hunt!

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #5 – Launch, Early Game Tips and More!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to the fifth instalment of Kamura Hunter’s Hub and our first post since [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] launched on Steam! 

To mark the occasion, we’ll be touching base on the game’s launch, helping new players settle into Kamura and known issues. 

We’ll then wrap things up with a mysterious tease for the future from Sunbreak Director Suzuki, so don’t miss out on that!


[h1]The hunt is on![/h1]

It’s been a little over two weeks since [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] launched on Steam and we want to say a huge THANK YOU for all of your amazing support so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/84b768f991b6ac57bf48308f71e3badccbbfc6c5.jpg[/img]

With so many Hunters joining the hunt we know Kamura is in the best possible hands and the Rampage can be defeated!

Whether [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] is your first Monster Hunter title, or you’re joining us from Monster Hunter World, welcome! We hope you’re having a great time and taking hunts to new action-packed heights with your Wirebugs!

Reading through your comments and feedback, we’re so pleased to see the PC specific additions such as HD Textures, 4K, voice chat, Ultrawide and unique filters going down so well, so thank you for letting us know!

We’d also like to take a moment to say thanks to those more experienced Hunters who are taking the time to answer questions from new players about weapons, armour skills and all things Monster Hunter on the forums. We see you spreading the goodness like a Hunting Horn main in an Urgent Quest!


[h1]Settling into Kamura![/h1]

[b]Guild Cross Armor[/b]

Looking for a small boost to help you with early quests as you find your feet as a Hunter? Then you’ll want to go and talk to Senri the Mailman in Kamura Village to claim your free Guild Cross armour set!

[i]The Mailman[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/4581d52589efe16d02c7f9143fe23aad5448f1fc.jpg[/img]

[i]The Set[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/15b028ebfbe858b3e235574d2723c2a6d39ffe23.jpg[/img]

The Guild Cross set is an optional armour set that grants a small boost for the early quests as you build experience, craft and upgrade your first weapons and search out new armour sets to build.

You can choose to wear the full set or pick out pieces to complement your armour skills from other sets.

Donning full Guild Cross will impart the following boons:
[list]
[*]120 base defence (24 per piece)
[*]A range of gathering and exploration armour skills
[/list]
Whilst this set is great for the start of [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i], keep in mind that as you progress up through the Village and Gathering Hub quest chains, you’ll discover that your armour becomes less effective and protecting you from damage – so keep a look out for stronger armour sets and pieces that compliment your playstyle by visiting Hamon the Blacksmith regularly! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/4b0b10a6ebd1a9cbce989d305c72cfc19587019d.jpg[/img]


[h1]Hunter’s Notes – Kamura Hunter Tips[/h1]

On the run up to launch we put together some posts that detail some key [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] features, such as Wirebugs, Silkbind Attacks and making the most of the Village!

Launch brought a lot of new Hunters to the community hub (Hello!!), so we’re just sharing a quick refresher on those topics for Hunters who are interested in getting a quick overview and some useful tips that will serve them well on the hunt…

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129434881277902033][b]Introducing Wirebugs & Mobility Usage[/b][/url] 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IH0hPqUqjJ2wsuUwik/giphy.gif[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129435606049210916][b]Wirebug Usage – Aerial Usage[/b][/url]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/tqtQMywNVGu3gVKYtN/giphy.gif[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129437417942234611][b]Offensive Wirebug Usage – Silkbind Attacks[/b][/url]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0PeQdh0YgnWCl5JjUs/giphy.gif[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129438777523823846][b]Getting Started: Village Tips[/b][/url]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/FtoZ9eFf2tGT2UXDyd/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]Known Issues – Feedback & Fixes[/h1]
 
Whilst bugs are the last thing we like to see, we’d like to take this opportunity to show our appreciation for players who have been taking the time to report and detail any issues they’ve encountered since launch.

One example of this was the “Failed to Save” bug which impacted a number of players at launch, stopping them creating a save file and starting the game. Thanks to the patience and feedback from those effected we were able to release a patch last week that fixed it! 

If you’ve been impacted by this bug, please make sure your game is up to date with Ver.3.6.1.1 and follow [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3123810455799967152]these instructions[/url] to apply the fix! 

The team are remaining vigilant and monitoring player feedback across the Steam forums should any other players encounter issues.

If you do encounter a bug, please let us know [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1446780/discussions/1/]HERE[/url] with as many details as you can provide on the issue, as well as information such as your PC specs. This will be very helpful at assisting the process.


[h1]Sunbreak Director Suzuki Update[/h1]

[i]Hello everyone! I'll be revealing some key phrases from today on! First one: "Kingdom Creatures."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d8bb29745967cfc255449bcbd3132ecfccb985a8.jpg[/img]

- Suzuki, Sunbreak Director[/i]


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks for taking the time to check it out.

We hope you’re all having a fantastic time with [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] and exploring everything Kamura has to offer.

We’ll be back again soon with our next post, and in the meantime, we’ll be reading through your comments here on Steam! You can also keep up to speed with all things Monster Hunter by following us on our [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]official Twitter account[/url].

Have a great weekend everyone, we’ll see you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Monster Hunter Rise patch fixes that PC save bug
notes.content:
A new Monster Hunter Rise PC patch is addressing a pretty significant hiccup that's been causing issues for first-time players on booting up the RPG game. It seems there was a bug that was causing the game to fail to "complete a proper save" when launching it for the first time, which meant it couldn't then start.

The new Monster Hunter patch - titled Patch Ver.3.6.1.1 if you want to be formal about it - was rolled out early on January 21, so if you're just about to dive in for the first time, you should hopefully not encounter the bug. If you did encounter it before the patch dropped, you'll just need to to follow a few steps developer Capcom has laid out after applying the patch to get things working smoothly.

This involves, first, disabling Steam Cloud and quitting out of the game, which you can do by unticking the check mark under the Steam Cloud section the game's properties (in 'General'). You'll then need to do a bit of local file deletion, re-booting the game to create new save data, hopping back out to re-enable Steam Cloud functioning, and uploading local files to the Steam Cloud. There are clear step-by-step instructions on exactly how to do this in the patch notes, so be sure to follow those carefully.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Notification of Patch Ver.3.6.1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Notification:[/h3]
We have released patch [b]Ver.3.6.1.1[/b] to address the following issue:

- When launching the full version of Monster Hunter Rise for the first time, the game fails to complete a proper save and cannot be started.


[u][b]If you experienced this issue before applying the patch,
please follow the below steps after applying the patch.[/b][/u]

[b]1. Disable Steam Cloud and quit the game.[/b]

Go to your Library in the Steam client, right click on Monster Hunter Rise, then select [Properties] > [General] > [Steam Cloud] and remove the check mark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/fc46d868212d43f9a2594abeee1c595401d34297.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Delete save data from the local files for the full version.[/b]
Go to the below folder and delete the [b]"remote"[/b] folder.

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\userdata\(User ID)\1446780\
[list]
[*][b]*Be careful not to delete the wrong folder!
It is advised you copy the folders to another location before deleting them just to be safe.[/b]
[/list]
[b]3. Launch the game and create new save data. [/b]

[b]4. Quit the game, and enable the Steam Cloud function you disabled in step 1.[/b]

[b]5. The next time you launch the game, select  「Upload to the Steam Cloud」 in the dialogue window that appears.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/e879848a755a46dbc87a702e132e3d0b287885ce.jpg[/img]


[h3]Note:[/h3]
This patch will change your version of Monster Hunter Rise from Ver.3.6.1.0 to [b]Ver.3.6.1.1[/b].

Monster Hunter Rise does not allow for matchmaking between different versions of the game.
This means that players who applied the patch will no longer be able to matchmake with players who haven't applied the patch, so please keep this in mind.

You can check the version info at the bottom right of the Title Screen.



We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #1 – MH Rise Tips (Wirebug) & Player Demo Feedback!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, 
 
Welcome to Hunter’s Hub, our new, regular community update where we at Capcom can touch base with you on current community topics right here on Steam. We’ll be chatting about [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] and the upcoming expansion [i]Sunbreak[/i], and share updates directly from the Monster Hunter team!  

As this is our first entry, we’re going to be using it as an introduction, but if there’s anything you’d like to see the team talk about in future posts, let us know in the comments!  

[i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] is coming to PC on January 12th, 2022 and we can’t wait for you to experience a whole new journey here on Steam as you seek to save Kamura from the dreaded Rampage. 

We’re also very excited about the expansion, [i]Sunbreak[/i], coming Summer 2022 and will look to share updates straight from Director Suzuki and the team with you in our future posts! 


[h1][b]Beginner’s Guide – Wirebug Actions: Part 1![/b][/h1]

[b]From the New World to Kamura Village…[/b]

With the release of our free [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] Steam Demo, we’ve seen an influx of both players new to the Monster Hunter series, as well as more experienced Hunters from [i]Monster Hunter: World[/i] and [i]Iceborne[/i]!  

To all of you, we’d like to extend a huge welcome, we hope you’ve enjoyed battling the monsters in the demo! 

Those of you coming from the “New World” will have likely quickly noticed some differences in hunting methods, Hunters from Kamura don’t sport a Slinger or even a Clutch Claw! Instead, they utilise Wirebugs, a beetle that’s native to the region surrounding Kamura Village. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/24d020c3c3cbb0fceae9038fd77232cad511bc17.jpg[/img]

These creatures produce a super-strong silk that Hunters can utilise not only for mobility, but also unleashing unique and special attacks with their chosen weapon! 

From wall running, to evading, Silkbind attacks and quickly recovering from hard hitting monster attacks, Wirebugs give you unparalleled control and flexibility during a hunt. 

By mastering the basics of Wirebugs you’ll enjoy a new range of freedom in Monster Hunter, both when exploring and fighting!  

To aid you in this, we’ll be sharing more details about Wirebugs over the next few posts. This week is all about mobility! 


[h1]Wirebugs and You – Mobility! [/h1]

First things first, as a Hunter you’ll have access to two Wirebug charges by default. All Wirebug moves in [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] rely on Wirebug charges to use. The good news is these charges aren’t finite and recover over a short period of time after each use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/faa8287fe8707e0c5cea1844a1e8b95d48d75e90.jpg[/img]

As we delve into the different actions you can utilise around Wirebugs and mobility, we’ll be explaining them as if you’re using the default controller layout. For our mouse and keyboard Hunters, just apply this knowledge to your preferred key bindings! 


[h1]Mobility – Basic Movement[/h1] 

Wirebug moves are contextual, meaning you’ll get different results depending on whether your weapons are drawn or sheathed.  

Non-offensive mobility moves are all performed when your weapon is sheathed, so make sure that’s the case when attempting to do these moves yourself! 

[b]Wiredashing[/b]

Wiredashing is an ability that grants you a quick burst of speed and movement wherever your Hunter facing, allowing you to engage, or disengage from threats. 

Keep in mind that these moves are also ideal for traversing the various locales you’ll be hunting in, especially when searching for useful Endemic Life! 

Every Wirebug move you perform will first need to be initiated by holding the left trigger, also known as the Wirebug button, and then pressing a second button.  

Let’s look at what moves are available to you below:  

[b]“Ground”[/b] 

Pulling you along the ground, this move is ideal for quickly repositioning in a fight or moving swiftly through the area. 

This move is activated my holding left trigger and pressing B on an Xbox controller whilst your Hunter is on the ground. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/GCbKMUyzR0srBuJNtL/giphy.gif[/img]

If used whilst in the air, this move will pull you diagonally downwards instead. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WBqykREP5ZnCrzD46O/giphy.gif[/img]


[b]"Aerial"[/b]

Quickly gain aerial advantage over your opponents or use it to dodge certain attacks!  

This move is activated my holding left trigger and pressing Y on an Xbox controller whilst your Hunter is on the ground. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IH0hPqUqjJ2wsuUwik/giphy.gif[/img]

If used whilst in the air, you’ll maintain your height and continue moving forward. 


[b]"Directional"[/b]

Propel your Hunter exactly where you aim, giving yourself a high level of precision whether you’re grounded or in the air! 

This move is activated by holding left trigger and pressing right trigger on your chosen controller. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/OTWboYgAyolQTpesEh/giphy.gif[/img]

That wraps up part 1 of our introduction to Wirebugs and how you can use them for superior mobility in hunts!  

In our next post, we’ll showcase even more Wirebug uses both for exploration and use in combat situations.


[h1]Monster Hunter Rise – PC Demo Feedback & Bug Reports[/h1]

Since we released the PC Demo, the dev team have been keenly reading and collating your feedback and bug reports. Thanks to everyone who has taken the time to share what they thought of the demo, including those who, unfortunately, ran into some issues. 

Thanks to your reports, the dev team are now able to investigate known bugs. 

Please check out our Steam forum thread dedicated to troubleshooting and reporting issues [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1446780/discussions/0/3122675677662891743/]HERE[/url].  


[h1]Join the hunt and get ready to face the Rampage![/h1] 

You can keep up to speed with all things [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] and support the game ahead of launch by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist! 

If you’re ready to join the hunt and save Kamura Village you can also pre-purchase now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1446780/MONSTER_HUNTER_RISE/ 

Hunters who pre-purchase will also receive:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/59eb792d4b4b1b3c0d597fab5e0f51078692651b.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Palamute Retriever Costume layered armor 
[*]Palico Forest Cat Costume layered armor 
[*]Novice Talisman for some extra assistance in the early stages 
[/list]

[h1]Meet Suzuki – Director of Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak! [/h1]

Speaking of introductions, we’ve got someone who’s keen to say hi… 

[i]“Hello! This is Suzuki, Director of Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak. I'll be taking over from Director Ichinose for the next stage of Monster Hunter Rise! Development is currently underway so I'll be here periodically to share more info about Sunbreak! Please look forward to it.”[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/bd8ff25811f4fd00b30df184d116f4e90b4e1e4e.jpg[/img]

[i]“Today, I've brought you some concept illustrations for our flagship monster, Malzeno. 
We started with a general concept, and narrowed down the direction little by little! Note that his final design looks quite different. 
 
- Suzuki”[/i] 


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1] 

That wraps up our first community post here on Steam! Thank you for taking the time to check it out. We hope you liked it! 

We’ll be back soon with the next Kamura Hunter’s Hub, we look forward to talking more [i]Monster Hunter Rise[/i] and [i]Sunbreak[/i] with you then! 

In the meantime, we’ll be reading your thoughts and feedback from the demo on the Steam forums, so keep it coming! 

- The Monster Hunter Community Team
